title: Right-moving zipper step on one lane
statement: Let $base$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes, choose a lane $lane<k$, optional state $q$, state $q'$, integer $z$, lists $l,r$ of optional symbols, and optional symbols $a,b$. Applying the action that writes $b$ on lane $lane$, moves that head one cell right, and enters state $q'$ to the zipper configuration at frontier $z$ with left list $l$ and right list $a::r$ yields the zipper configuration at frontier $z+1$ with left list $b::l$ and right list $r$, state $q'$, and all other configuration data as specified by the base configuration.
hypotheses_covered: $base$ is a configuration with $k$ work tapes
$l,r$ are finite lists of optional symbols
replaced:
Applying a right-moving single-lane action that writes a symbol $b$ to a
single-active-lane configuration whose unprocessed list begins with a cell $a$
consumes $a$, pushes $b$ onto the processed stack, advances the frontier by
one, and passes to the designated control; all inactive data is unchanged.
